title: What would a new Israeli government mean for Arab neighbors?

blocks.text: Supporters of Palestinian candidate Yousef Jabareen of the Joint List party celebrate early exit poll results, at the party’s headquarters in Nazareth, during Israel’s legislative election. As Israeli politicians begin to try to build a coalition government, after an election that saw no clear winner, response from politicians in surrounding Arab countries has been muted or non-existent. This may be because, for the time being anyway, it remains unclear as to whether the new Israeli government will continue with “business as usual” under incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu or whether a new government headed by Netanyahu’s opponents will take what is […]...
